recommendations.title: Improve Ad Engagement to Boost CTR
recommendations.whats_happening: The current CTR is only 0.04 (4%), indicating a low engagement level with the audience and reflecting poor intent quality.
what_you_should_do: Revise ad copy and visuals to better resonate with the audience of first-time investors.
Apply changes in the Google Ads platform for the 'Unknown' campaign.
Conduct A/B testing on revised creatives to evaluate performance improvements.
recommendations.why_this_matters: Higher engagement in terms of click-through rates can lead to increased quality traffic, essential for maximizing future conversions and overall effectiveness.
recommendations.expected_impact: Expected CTR improvement to 0.07 (7%), potentially increasing clicks to 4191.

recommendations.title: Address Traffic Quality Issues
recommendations.whats_happening: The gap between clicks (2113) and a CTR of 0.04 suggests that many clicks may not be from highly interested users, resulting in low traffic quality impacting downstream conversion potential.
what_you_should_do: Refine targeting criteria in Google Ads to focus on higher intent audience segments.
Use audience insights to adjust demographic and interest-based targeting parameters of the campaign.
Review and select only top-performing keywords related to personal loans for the campaign.
recommendations.why_this_matters: Improving traffic quality directly correlates to better potential customer engagement and conversion rates, ultimately leading to revenue growth.
recommendations.expected_impact: Anticipated increase in conversion rate from 8% to 10% with higher quality clicks.

recommendations.title: Monitor and Optimize Budget Usage
recommendations.whats_happening: Current cost per click (CPC) is $1.26, which appears reasonable; however, the low CTR hints at inefficiencies that could lead to wasted budget on ineffective ads.
what_you_should_do: Set up weekly tracking for CPC and CTR performance to identify fluctuations and adjust bids accordingly in the Google Ads platform.
Increase focus on high-performing keywords and decrease spend on low-performing ones based on real-time data.
Consider implementing negative keywords to filter out non-relevant traffic.
recommendations.why_this_matters: Efficient budget management ensures that finance allocation leads to meaningful engagement and sustained revenue growth.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduce CPC by ~$0.20 through effective bidding strategies and reassessment of keyword targeting.

recommendations.title: Obtain Missing Landing Page Data
recommendations.whats_happening: Landing page view data is missing, which prevents a full understanding of how well clicks are converting into actual interactions or leads.
what_you_should_do: First, obtain landing page view data by implementing tracking tools like Google Analytics on the landing pages to capture user behavior after clicking on ads.
Evaluate the landing page experience and alignment with ad messaging for potential optimizations post-data acquisition.
recommendations.why_this_matters: Having this data is crucial for evaluating how effectively clicks convert into leads or sales, which ultimately impacts the success of the campaign.
recommendations.expected_impact: Establish baseline for landing page performance leading to further optimizations and improved conversion tracking.
